Environment packs include prepared unused props; file status distinguishes these from referenced exports.
ENV-04 is used only for the Golden Fragment memory illustration, not a playable orchard level.
Tavi uses the existing seven extracted animation clips, with archive provenance recorded separately from new Chapter 1 preparations.
Sources remain unchanged. No checklist checkboxes or prior approval flags are altered by runtime integration.
